option_relations.rationale: Lymphangioma does not match the clinical and histological findings described in the vignette.

Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma (Dabska tumor) is a rare vascular tumor that matches some of the histological features described in the vignette, but the clinical presentation is not typical.
Benign lymphangioendothelioma (BLAE) matches the clinical and histological findings described in the vignette, including the presence of promontory signs and hemosiderin deposits.
Pseudo-Kaposi’s sarcoma (acroangiodermatitis) does not match the clinical and histological findings described in the vignette.
